name: What is the process for getting new flooring installed with Affordable Home Remodeling?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting new flooring installed with Affordable Home Remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with a free consultation to discuss your needs, preferences, and budget. Next, we conduct an on-site visit to measure the area, assess the subfloor, and provide material recommendations. Following this, you receive a detailed, transparent quote. Once approved, we schedule the installation at your convenience. Our professional team handles material delivery, old flooring removal, subfloor preparation, and the new flooring installation, ensuring quality workmanship and minimal disruption. We conclude with a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, on-site assessment, detailed quote, scheduling, professional installation, and a final walkthrough for satisfaction.
